name: Risme Mohomad Riyas
headline:
Practical software.
Built around your business.
intro: I build web applications, business management systems, and mobile experiences that connect your customers, your team, and your daily operations.

projects.title: Spa & Salon Management
projects.summary: A management system spanning the salon website, staff administration, point of sale, and customer mobile experience.
projects.problem: Salon teams need to coordinate services, professional availability, memberships, and the customer journey.
projects.solution: Built connected booking and management workflows, including staff availability, multi-service appointments, memberships, and POS integration.
projects.note: Web booking, service and product browsing, and administration are shown here. Mobile screenshots will be added later.

projects.title: FitSync
projects.summary: A multitenant gym management project with owner administration and a connected member application.
projects.problem: Gym owners and members need distinct experiences while each gym’s data and configuration remain separate.
projects.solution: Developed a multitenant backend, owner dashboard, authentication, and a member app with fitness and community features.
projects.note: University team project. My individual responsibilities and team credits can be added in the editor.

projects.title: DiscoverScienceLK
projects.summary: An education website rebuild connecting quizzes, student progress, achievements, and teacher administration.
projects.problem: Learning activities and results need an accessible student experience and practical tools for the teacher.
projects.solution: Rebuilt the platform with student and admin dashboards, quiz management, activity filtering, and legacy WordPress data migration.
projects.note: Screenshots show the sign-in experience, public home page, and administration dashboard.

projects.title: Rider Choice POS
projects.summary: A point-of-sale and inventory project for a bike modification shop, covering products, purchasing, jobs, and cash movement.
projects.problem: A specialist retailer needs billing and stock control that reflect both product sales and modification work.
projects.solution: Built POS and inventory workflows with suppliers, purchasing, goods received notes, modification jobs, expenses, and reporting.
projects.note: Screenshots show the business dashboard and point-of-sale workspace.
